def: a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn

occurrences.text: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
